children.zh-CN: 徽章依附的元素的 snippet；缺省时徽章独立显示。
children.en-US: Snippet for the element the badge is attached to. Without it the badge stands alone.

count.zh-CN: 徽章内容，数字、字符串或 snippet；传 snippet 时直接渲染该 snippet，并去掉类型与主题样式类。
count.en-US: Badge content as a number, string or snippet. A snippet is rendered as given and removes the type and theme classes.

classNames.zh-CN: 内部各部位的类名，键为 count，值的写法同 class（字符串、数组或对象），与组件自带的类名合并。
classNames.en-US: Class names of the inner parts, keyed by count; values take anything class takes (string, array or object) and merge with the built-in classes.

dot.zh-CN: 显示为小圆点，不展示内容。
dot.en-US: Shows a small dot instead of the content.

overflowCount.zh-CN: 数字内容的最大展示值，超出后显示为 `${overflowCount}+`；只对数字生效，0 视为未设置。
overflowCount.en-US: Maximum number shown; larger numbers display as `${overflowCount}+`. Applies to numbers only, and 0 counts as unset.

position.zh-CN: 徽章相对被包裹元素的位置；缺省时 RTL 的 ConfigProvider 下为 leftTop，否则为 rightTop。
position.en-US: Badge position relative to the wrapped element. Defaults to leftTop under an RTL ConfigProvider and rightTop otherwise.

styles.zh-CN: 内部各部位的样式字符串，键同 classNames。
styles.en-US: Style strings of the inner parts, keyed like classNames.

theme.en-US: Badge theme: solid, light or inverted.

type.en-US: Badge type: primary, secondary, tertiary, danger, warning or success.
